insight.title: Your Immune System Doesn’t Know Your Eyes Exist
insight.subtitle: Why your body treats your eyes like a foreign threat.

sections.text: If your immune system ever "discovered" your eyes, it would immediately try to destroy them. Your body treats your eyes as foreign objects, completely unaware they have been part of you since birth.
To keep your vision clear, your eyes stay hidden behind a chemical wall that blocks out your internal defenses. This barrier keeps your white blood cells from ever noticing the back of your eye.
If a deep injury breaks that wall, your immune system finally spots the "invader." It will quickly attack the injured eye—and might even move over to destroy the healthy one, as well.
Your vision is a secret your body isn’t allowed to know.
